# Logi

Logi is an open-source community-management platform for Hell Let Loose communities. It helps Discord community managers plan events, build rosters, publish match results, and coordinate operations with a companion bot.

## Public resources

- [Logi home](https://logibot.tech/en): Product overview and sign-in entry point.
- [Logi Wiki](https://logibot.tech/wiki): Product documentation and setup guides.
- [Getting started](https://logibot.tech/wiki/getting-started): Introductory guide for community managers.
- [Discord bot setup](https://logibot.tech/wiki/discord-bot-setup): Bot installation and configuration guide.
- [API reference](https://logibot.tech/api/v1/docs): Authenticated API documentation.
- [OpenAPI document](https://logibot.tech/api/v1/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract.
- [Privacy policy](https://logibot.tech/en/privacy-policy): Personal-data processing information.
- [Terms of service](https://logibot.tech/en/tos): Service terms.

## Crawling guidance

Public marketing pages and the wiki may be indexed. Dashboard, sign-in, account-linking, and API routes require authentication or are not intended for crawling; follow [robots.txt](https://logibot.tech/robots.txt) for the authoritative crawl rules.
